name: Legends of the Tidesages

aliases: what is legends of the tidesages
faq.answer: It is a magical tome delivered to expand the library kept by Garion Wendell in Stormwind or Owen Thadd in the Undercity.
faq.q: What is Legends of the Tidesages?

aliases: who wants legends of the tidesages
where to take legends of the tidesages
faq.answer: The library keeper accepts the work to preserve its knowledge and add to the collection: Garion Wendell in Stormwind for the Alliance, or Owen Thadd in the Undercity for the Horde.

aliases: what happens after legends of the tidesages
faq.answer: The scholars ask that you bring them any further magical writings you recover that could aid the library.
faq.q: Can more books be brought to the library?

sections.body: Librarians in Stormwind and the Undercity seek to broaden their understanding of arcane and historical lore. Each volume retrieved from the wider world preserves lore that might otherwise vanish into obscurity.
sections.title: Gathering Knowledge

summary: A tome of obscure lore has made its way to a library keeper in Stormwind or the Undercity. Scholars there welcome such additions, eager to deepen their collection of arcane knowledge.
attribution: In-game quest text: Legends of the Tidesages
